Good food, good service
Oct 2024 • Friends
During our recent trip to Cat Ba Island, we stumbled upon Nyugen Chat Coffee while searching for a banana boat ride. Though we didn’t find the ride, we were delighted by our brunch experience at this charming café.

Ambiance:
Nyugen Chat Coffee has a welcoming vibe with cozy decor, making it an ideal spot to relax and enjoy a meal. The atmosphere was perfect for a leisurely brunch.

Service:
Elvis and his colleague provided exceptional service, going out of their way to accommodate our vegetarian preferences, which is often a challenge in Vietnam. Their attentiveness made our visit even more enjoyable.

Menu:
We ordered a coconut coffee, cold coffee with chocolate, and a banana smoothie, all of which were refreshing and delicious. For our meal, we chose a vegetarian pizza and French fries. To our surprise, the quality of the food exceeded our expectations, proving that finding vegetarian options in Vietnam is possible!

Dinner Visit:
Impressed by our brunch, we returned for dinner and tried crispy vegetable rolls, vegetarian pasta with tomato sauce, and a vegetarian hot pot. Each dish was flavorful, but the hot pot was a standout—an amazing first-time experience for us.

Value for Money:
Both our brunch and dinner offered good value, with generous portions and quality ingredients.

Conclusion:
With its great food, inviting atmosphere, and friendly service, we highly recommend Nyugen Chat Coffee, especially for vegetarians and Indian travelers. It's a gem on Cat Ba Island!
